courses.title: Protective Driving Operations Certification (PDOC)
courses.description: A three-day certification course introducing students to the principles, procedures, and countermeasures of protective driving. Covers vehicle dynamics, route planning, evasive driving, and emergency maneuvers essential for professional drivers of corporate clients or at-risk individuals.

courses.title: Protective Security Operations Certification (PSOC)
courses.description: A five-day certification program designed for private security, law enforcement, and DoD professionals. PSOC trains students in contemporary executive protection methods and is approved for training by multiple federal, state, and corporate organizations.

courses.title: Protective Pistol Skills (PPS)
courses.description: The weapons-centric component of PSOC, Protective Pistol Skills is an entirely range-based two-day course. Students learn individual firearms tactics as they apply to third-person and principal defense, with a focus on safe and practical concealed handgun use during protective operations.

courses.title: Residential Security Operations Certification (RSOC)
courses.description: A four-day certification course for personnel on estate security details or individuals pursuing entry-level protective positions. Students learn the contemporary methods and best practices for residential security operations, balancing professional security skills with client comfort.

courses.title: Progressive Precision Rifle – Foundations (PPRF1)
courses.description: A one-day foundational precision rifle course covering the fundamentals of long-range shooting. Students develop consistent technique, an understanding of ballistics, and the ability to make accurate first-round hits at extended distances.

courses.title: Intermediate Progressive Precision Rifle (IPR2)
courses.description: A two-day intermediate precision rifle course for students with foundational long-range skills. Builds on PPRF1 with more complex engagements, positional shooting, and practical problem sets at greater distances.

courses.title: Advanced Progressive Precision Rifle (APR3)
courses.description: A two-day advanced precision rifle course for experienced long-range shooters. Students refine technique under demanding conditions with complex, time-sensitive engagements requiring consistent performance at the highest skill level.

courses.title: Protective Emergency Casualty Care (PECC)
courses.description: A two-day protection-focused medical training program for executive protection, residential security, and corporate response teams. Graduates receive nationally recognized NAEMT and American Red Cross credentials, establishing a unified medical standard for protective professionals.

courses.title: Covert Operations & Protective Surveillance (COPS)
courses.description: A three-day course in covert operations and protective surveillance techniques used by executive protection professionals. Students develop skills in mobile and static surveillance, counter-surveillance, and covert team coordination in real-world urban environments.

courses.title: Nevada Armed Security Officer Certification (NASOC)
courses.description: This two-day NASOC program exceeds Nevada's required course content and qualification standards for security firearms training. PFC's brand and reputation depend on graduating students who are among the most capable armed security officers in the state.
